segments.text: Keep your attention on the single point where each word appears. One word. Then the next. The noise around the edges begins to fall away.
Your focus narrows to a clean, bright line. Sharp. Steady. Everything that does not matter goes quiet, and what matters stands out clearly.
You hold this clarity easily. Your mind is a clear signal now, ready, precise, and fully here.
Carry this sharpness forward as you lift your eyes, alert, focused, and ready to begin.
